title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Total Loss Valuation Schedule by State
content:
The total-loss figures of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage are the same on all six deductible options (Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000, $1,000, $750, $500, $250 and $100 Deductible). The state is the policy state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the vehicle is scheduled on.

## State schedule (every deductible option)

| Policy state | Total-loss threshold, percent of actual cash value | Sales tax percentage paid in a total-loss settlement | Title transfer fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| OH | 75 | 5.75 | 15.00 |
| IN | 70 | 7.00 | 15.00 |
| KY | 75 | 6.00 | 9.00 |
| VA | 75 | 4.15 | 15.00 |
| WV | 75 | 6.00 | 15.00 |

The threshold is the percentage of actual cash value at or above which the repair estimate makes the vehicle a total loss.

## Valuation and settlement terms (every deductible option)

| Term | Figure |
|---|---|
| Comparable vehicles in the valuation report used to set actual cash value, minimum | 3 |
| Radius around the garaging ZIP within which comparables are drawn | 150 miles |
| Settlement paid within this many calendar days after the signed title and the settlement acceptance are received | 10 |
| Customer may keep a total-loss vehicle with its salvage value deducted (owner-retained salvage) | Allowed |
| Unrepaired prior damage noted in the valuation deducted from actual cash value | Applies |
| New car replacement, age limit of the vehicle | 24 months |
| New car replacement, maximum odometer at the loss | 24000 miles |
| Loan/lease payoff benefit cap, percent of actual cash value | 25 |

## Threshold illustration (hypothetical figures)

A vehicle with an actual cash value of 20000.00 garaged under an IN policy is a total loss when the repair estimate is at or above 70 percent of that value, that is 14000.00; an estimate of 13999.99 is below it. Under an OH policy the same vehicle reaches the threshold at 15000.00 (75 percent).
